dct_title_s: General Plan Land Use Designations, Nevada County, California, 2020
dct_description_sm: The Nevada County General Plan is the long-term policy guide for the physical, economic and environmental future of the County. See the Planning Department General Plan web page for more details including definition of specific land use codes.
